connector.name: Shotpipe - Screenshots & OG Images
connector.registryDescription: Screenshot any URL and see it, or mint a social card - hosted, SSRF-safe, cached. No Chrome to run.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package shotpipe-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the podop29 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: SHOTPIPE_KEY
env.description: Shotpipe API key id (starts with k_). Free at https://shotpipe.io/signup.

env.name: SHOTPIPE_SECRET
env.description: Shotpipe HMAC signing secret. Requests are signed locally; the secret never leaves the process.

env.name: SHOTPIPE_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL for a self-hosted Shotpipe instance. Defaults to https://shotpipe.io.
